nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written in approve and decremented in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Private sale count limit set by init and read by condition.
Private minimum sale amount set by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount set by init and read by condition.
Private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition.
Private whitelist mapping consulted in ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Whitelisted trade address read in ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
Total token supply, computed with unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used in init and constructor scaling arithmetic.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition.
Internal view sale-limit checker over _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address, granting full state control of the contract.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total with unchecked multiplication and updates balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256 of sorted tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and the initial UNI allowance.
msg.sender, the caller-supplied address used for authorization checks and state writes across the contract.
Low-level delegatecall executed in delegate, allowing arbitrary code execution in the context of this contract.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) in the constructor without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.

Amount parameter of transfer.

Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Source address parameter of ensure used for whitelist checks.
Destination address parameter of ensure used for owner check.

Amount parameter of condition compared against _minSale and _maxSale.

Allowance amount parameter of approve.

Calldata bytes parameter of delegate forwarded to the delegatecall.
Sale count parameter of init assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum sale parameter of init assigned to _minSale.
Maximum sale parameter of init assigned to _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Factory address parameter of pairFor.
First token address parameter of pairFor.
Second token address parameter of pairFor.
Name string parameter of the constructor.
Symbol string parameter of the constructor.
Initial supply parameter of the constructor used in the scaling multiplication.
Local variable _UNI holding the computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure.
Local variable total in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.
Loop index variable i in batchSend.
Loop-local recipient variable _to in batchSend.
Local variable token0, the lower-sorted token address in pairFor.
Local variable token1, the higher-sorted token address in pairFor.
Local variable pair, the computed pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and decrement.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
transfer unconditionally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to succeed before mutating state.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum[_from] participation counter.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to decide whether to bypass the sale condition.
ensure compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the per-address sale cap.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
delegate reads owner for its autorization check.
init reads owner for its authorization check.
init assigns the scaled token parameter to _minSale.
init assigns the scaled maxToken parameter to _maxSale.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
init reads decimals for the 10**decimals scaling arithmetic.
batchSend reads owner for its authorization check.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries using unchecked addition and subtraction.
setTradeAddress reads owner for its authorization check.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
The constructor grants an unlimited UNI allowance for msg.sender.
The constructor computes totalSupply with an unchecked scaling multiplication.
The constructor assigns the name parameter to the name state variable.
The constructor assigns the symbol parameter to the symbol state variable.
The constructor reads the decimals constant for the supply scaling arithmetic.
delegate performs a low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
transferFrom underflows allowance[_from][msg.sender] because the subtraction has no SafeMath guard.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing an overflowed total.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
The constructor multiplies _supply by 10**decimals without SafeMath, allowing a wrapped totalSupply.
transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses _from to index balances, allowances and ensure.
transferFrom uses _to as the credit recipient.
transferFrom uses _value for the allowance and balance arithmetic.
ensure consumes _from for the whitelist comparison and condition call.
ensure consumes _to for the owner whitelist comparison.
ensure forwards _value to condition.
condition indexes _onSaleNum with _from.
condition compares _value against _minSale and _maxSale.
approve writes the allowance for the _spender parameter.
approve stores the _value parameter as the allowance amount.
delegate delegatecalls to the owner-supplied target address parameter a.
delegate forwards the calldata bytes parameter b to the delegatecall.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
init assigns the scaled token parameter to _minSale.
init assigns the scaled maxToken parameter to _maxSale.
batchSend iterates over the recipient array parameter _tos.
batchSend uses _value in the total multiplication and per-recipient credits.
setTradeAddress writes the addr parameter into tradeAddress.
pairFor uses the factory parameter in the pair address hash.
pairFor uses tokenA in the sorted token pair computation.
pairFor uses tokenB in the sorted token pair computation.
The constructor stores the name parameter.
The constructor stores the symbol parameter.
The constructor uses _supply in the totalSupply scaling multiplication.
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local variable _UNI and compares it against _from.
batchSend computes the local total variable with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend uses the local loop index i to iterate over recipients.
batchSend caches each recipient in the local variable _to.
pairFor assigns the lower-sorted address to the local token0.
pairFor assigns the higher-sorted address to the local token1.
pairFor stores the computed address in the local variable pair.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter has no independent semantics outside transfer and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter only exists as an argument of transfer and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _from parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _to parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter directly feeds the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic operations.
The _from parameter is only used for the whitelist checks inside ensure and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _to parameter is only used for the owner comparison inside ensure and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter is passed straight through ensure into condition and is absorbed by that callee.
The _from parameter is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter is only compared against sale limits inside condition and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter is only stored as the allowance inside approve and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The target address parameter directly determines the delegatecall destination and is absorbed by that unsafe operation.
The calldata parameter is the payload of the delegatecall and is absorbed by that unsafe operation.
The saleNum parameter is only assigned to _saleNum inside init and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The token parameter is only used for the _minSale scaling arithmetic inside init and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The maxToken parameter is only used for the _maxSale scaling arithmetic inside init and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The recipient array parameter is only iterated inside batchSend and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The _value parameter directly feeds the unchecked total multiplication in batchSend.
The addr parameter is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The factory parameter is only hashed inside pairFor and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The tokenA parameter is only used in the sorting and hashing inside pairFor and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The tokenB parameter is only used in the sorting and hashing inside pairFor and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The name parameter is only stored during construction and is absorbed by the constructor node.
The symbol parameter is only stored during construction and is absorbed by the constructor node.
The _supply parameter directly feeds the unchecked totalSupply multiplication in the constructor.
The _UNI local is transient scratch state computed and consumed entirely within ensure.
The total local is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
The loop index local only exists inside the batchSend iteration and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The loop recipient local only exists inside the batchSend iteration and is absorbed by its owning function node.
The token0 local is transient sorting state used only inside pairFor.
The token1 local is transient sorting state used only inside pairFor.
The pair local is the return value computed entirely inside pairFor.
